    How to play

    1. On your turn, press anywhere on the table and drag back like a slingshot. The dotted line shows where your pen will go.
    2. Release to flick. The further you pull, the harder the shot.
    3. Pick a curve before you shoot to bend around a blocker.
    4. A pen is out when its centre leaves the table. Last pen standing scores a point. First to five wins.
